name: Blazing Fury of Torrential Fragrance
source:
You are the chosen one. You have been chosen to enter a world devoid of hope and any sort of artistic ability.
Keep your wits about you and you may reach the harem end. Failure, however, will result in blindness and sodomy.
translation:
你是被选中的人。你被选中进入一个既无希望、也毫无艺术才能可言的世界。
保持清醒，你或许能够抵达后宫结局；一旦失败，等待你的则是失明与鸡奸。
